entities.name: ESM STATUS
entities.description: Message sent by the network or the UE to pass information on the status of the indicated EPS bearer context and report certain error conditions.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer context for which status information is provided.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifies the procedure transaction associated with the ESM message.

entities.name: ESM status message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as ESM STATUS.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: Provides the cause value indicating the status or error condition for the EPS bearer context.

relations.description: ESM STATUS message contains the Protocol discriminator information element.
ESM STATUS message contains the EPS bearer identity information element.
ESM STATUS message contains the Procedure transaction identity information element.
ESM STATUS message contains the ESM status message identity information element.
ESM STATUS message contains the ESM cause information element.
